title: OpenAI acquires tech news show TBPN; Fidji Simo says the move aims to "help create a space for a real, constructive conversation about the changes AI creates" (Katie Deighton/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Katie Deighton / Wall Street Journal: OpenAI acquires tech news show TBPN; Fidji Simo says the move aims to “help create a space for a real, constructive conversation about the changes AI creates” — TBPN staff will help with marketing and communications at OpenAI but keep their editorial independence, the ChatGPT parent says
